subject: Keep access to your Northstar pay statements
body:
Hi Alex,

Your company sign-in is disabled, but your pay records are available through Northstar Pay Archive. The attached guide explains personal registration. Our records show you have not finished registration.

The October 1 invitation expired on October 16. Please request a new invitation rather than reusing it.

Northstar Payroll
